output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's account to any value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing a user to cause an integer overflow on the recipients balance, if it occurs, it will be permanent.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing a user to cause an integer overflow on the recipients balance, if it occurs, it will be permanent.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[msg.sender] < amount, allowing a user to set the balance of an arbitrary user's account to any value.
